stories.title: Army releases new maps showing potential locations of lead exposure during Friday's controlled detonation
stories.summary: One map shows potential locations for airborne lead exposure, while the other shows locations of possible surface exposure.

stories.title: Middletown residents protest planned lead azide detonations at Iowa Army Ammunition Plant
stories.summary: People gathered in Middletown to protest the Army's planned lead azide detonations, raising concerns about potential health risks and a lack of transparency.

stories.title: Des Moines gamers anticipate long-awaited midnight launch of Grand Theft Auto 6
stories.summary: The video game releases on the X-Box Series X and S and Playstation 5 on Thursday at midnight local time.

stories.title: Iowa vape shop owner 'devastated' by new e-cigarette restrictions
stories.summary: Iowa's new e-cigarette regulations could slash Route 69 Vapor's revenue and limit choices for customers relying on vaping to quit smoking, owner Glenn said.

stories.title: Fitch Family Indoor Aquatic Center installs solar panels
stories.summary: 477 solar panels have been installed at the Fitch Family Indoor Aquatic Center in Ames.

stories.title: UnityPoint Health, Des Moines University launch Iowa Rural Health Collaborative
stories.summary: Initial work will begin in Webster County and focus on cancer prevention, screening and early detection.

stories.title: How should farmers prepare for Friday's planned lead azide detonation?
stories.summary: An Iowa State University beef field specialist recommended farmers take soil samples in advance of the detonation and keep animals from grazing in the landing zone.

stories.title: Some Iowa schools closing Friday as Army plans detonation of lead azide
stories.summary: The blasts will produce loud noise, vibrations and a dust plume containing some lead. The Army expects the dust to linger for no more than an hour.

stories.title: Middletown residents make plans to evacuate during Army's planned lead azide detonation
stories.summary: U.S. Army officials said the lead azide must be detonated where it's stored because if the material is moved, there's potential for an uncontrolled detonation.

stories.title: Wildlife rehab group raises concerns over planned Iowa Army Ammunition Plant detonations
stories.summary: Two controlled detonations planned in Middleville on Friday are raising concerns from a local wildlife rehabilitation group about potential lead exposure.

stories.title: Jefferson Lines and Amtrak partnership will link Iowa cities to national rail network
stories.summary: Des Moines, Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, Marshalltown, Davenport and Moline will have connecting bus lines to Amtrak routes.

stories.title: Drake University lists president's residence for sale for $1.5M
stories.summary: Six university presidents and their families have lived in the home since it was purchased by an anonymous benefactor in 1943.
